test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Match the Following 

 
 

 
 
**Column A - Literary Work **

 
 
 
**Column B - Type **

 
 
 

 
 
A.

 
 Naukar Ki Kameez 
 
 
(i)

 
 Poetry collection 
 
 

 
 
B.

 
 Lagbhag Jai Hind 
 
 
(ii)

 
 Novel 
 
 

 
 
C.

 
 Peed Par Kamra 
 
 
(iii)

 
 Short story collection 
 
 

 
 
D.

 
 Woh Aadmi Chala Gaya 
 
 
(iv)

 
 Poem

options.text: A - iii, B - ii, C - i, D - iv
A - ii, B - i, C - iii, D - iv
A - i, B - ii, C - iv, D - iii
A - ii, B - iii, C - i, D - iv

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A - **Naukar Ki Kameez**: This is categorized as a **Novel** (ii).
 
• B - **Lagbhag Jai Hind**: This literary work falls under **Poetry Collection** (i).
 
• C - **Peed Par Kamra**: Identified as a **Short Story Collection** (iii).
 
• D - **Woh Aadmi Chala Gaya**: This is a **Poem** (iv).
 
• Thus, the correct matching is: A - ii, B - i, C - iii, D - iv, corresponding to **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naukar Ki Kameez:** Authored by Vinod Kumar Shukla, this novel captures the struggles and aspirations of the common man in Indian society with subtle humor and deep insight.
 
• **Lagbhag Jai Hind:** A poetry collection by noted Hindi poet Agyeya, reflecting themes of patriotism, individuality, and existentialism.
 
• **Peed Par Kamra:** Penned by Vinod Kumar Shukla, this short story collection is known for its unique narrative style and depiction of ordinary lives in extraordinary ways.
 
• **Woh Aadmi Chala Gaya:** A poignant poem by renowned Hindi poet Shamsher Bahadur Singh, exploring themes of loss, departure, and the transient nature of human existence.
 
• **Literary Genres:** Novels, poetry collections, short stories, and poems are distinct literary forms, each offering unique ways of storytelling and expression.
